lockLevels.label: 标准
lockLevels.instruction: Preserve the garment category, main color, print and overall silhouette. Minor styling adjustments are allowed only when they do not change product recognition.

lockLevels.label: 严格
lockLevels.instruction: Preserve the exact garment category, silhouette, cut, proportions, color, print, pattern, fabric appearance, neckline, sleeve length, closures, seams, pockets, hem and visible branding. Do not redesign the garment.

lockLevels.label: 完全锁定
lockLevels.instruction: Reproduce the product as faithfully as possible. Product identity overrides scene, pose and styling instructions. Keep every visible garment feature unchanged and only modify the explicitly requested environment, camera or masked region.

templates.label: 日系穿搭广告
templates.direction: Japanese womenswear lifestyle advertisement, Japanese woman age 25-35 wearing the product, natural confident pose, refined Tokyo editorial styling, layered real-world setting with depth, warm gray and muted green environment, premium but approachable ecommerce photography

templates.label: 非白底场景
templates.direction: Non-white lifestyle scene in a bright Japanese apartment, cafe terrace or quiet Tokyo street, visible furniture or architecture, foreground and background layers, natural lived-in details, realistic depth, the product remains the clear focal point

templates.label: 模特上身
templates.direction: Full-body or three-quarter model wearing the product, natural standing or walking pose, coordinated daily outfit visible from head to toe, accurate fit around waist, shoulders and hem, vertical Japanese catalog photography

templates.label: 模特换衣
templates.direction: Photorealistic virtual try-on. Use every reference assigned as main product as the exact garment source and the reference assigned as person reference as the exact target model photograph. Identify whether the product is a top, bottom, dress, outerwear or coordinated set. Preserve the exact garment category, color, print, fabric appearance, neckline, sleeves, closures, pockets, seams, proportions and hem. Preserve the model identity, face, hair, expression, skin, body proportions, pose, hands, crop, camera, lighting, background, accessories and uncovered clothing. Replace only the clothing region covered by the supplied garment, remove the replaced garment cleanly, and reconstruct realistic fit, tension, folds, drape, occlusion and contact shadows. Produce one finished model photograph with no advertising text, cards, cutout inset, collage, logo or watermark.

templates.label: Rakuten 单张海报
templates.direction: Information-rich Japanese Rakuten fashion poster, large model with a complete product silhouette, layered editorial panels, restrained color swatches, measurement lines and benefit callouts, warm light-gray paper texture, limited vermilion and muted-gold accents

templates.label: 日本产品落地页（可选数量）
templates.direction: A coordinated selected-count Japanese mature-womenswear brand landing-page story made as exact 1500x2000 full-bleed vertical assets. Follow the selected subset of the brand-case rhythm: color lineup, fabric and construction macro, full-body model, fair comparison, Japanese lifestyle, styling, product-only color page, size/material guide and final craft close as assigned by the director. Inspect every main-product reference, preserve exact garment identity and every documented color/specification, rotate real variants across the suite, use Japanese women age roughly 35-55 with restrained local gestures, natural window light, warm white/ivory/light wood palette and Japanese-only Mincho/Gothic typography. Each page follows its assigned archetype and one primary selling point; the designated grid, detail and size pages keep their required information structure. Never invent colors, measurements, ratings, reviews, logos, prices or certifications.

templates.label: Amazon A+专区
templates.direction: A coordinated nine-module Amazon Japan A+ product content set made as exact 970x600 horizontal assets. First inspect the current product reference and prompt to identify the actual category, parts, materials, use method, benefits and specifications. Use one clear selling point or proof format per module, generate module 1 as the visual anchor, then preserve exact product identity, restrained Japanese lifestyle or professional photography, horizontal information hierarchy, generous safe margins and policy-safe copy across modules 2-9. Cover product hero, core improvement, structure and work method, materials and performance, localized use, options and suitable users, specifications and compatibility, use and maintenance, then product-value close. Never reuse apparel-specific sizing, styling or fabric modules unless the actual product is apparel. Never show prices, promotions, reviews, ratings, competitor claims, Amazon logos or Amazon interface elements.

templates.label: 乐天专区
templates.direction: A coordinated nine-image Rakuten Japan product-page set made as exact 1200x1200 square assets. First inspect the current product reference and prompt to identify the actual category, parts, materials, use method, benefits and specifications. Use one selling point or proof format per image, generate image 1 as the visual anchor, then preserve exact product identity, Japanese-localized lifestyle or professional photography, strong mobile-thumbnail recognition, information-rich but disciplined layout and policy-safe copy across images 2-9. Cover product hero, pain and improvement, structure and function, materials and performance, localized use, options and suitable users, specifications and compatibility, use and maintenance, then product-information close. Never reuse apparel-specific colors, styling, sizing or care modules unless the actual product is apparel. Never fabricate prices, discounts, rankings, awards, reviews, Rakuten logos or interface elements.

templates.label: COD国家专区
templates.direction: A coordinated thirty-image country-targeted COD landing-page set made as exact 750x1000 full-bleed vertical assets: eight conversion-focused main images followed by twenty-two product-specific detail images. First inspect the supplied product reference and current prompt to identify the actual category, parts, materials, use method, main benefits and secondary details. Use a strict one-page-one-benefit story: every page has one locked selling point and one visibly different display effect, and every photograph, inset, icon, arrow and label must prove that point only. Rotate through hook hero, user experience, credibility context, extreme macro, fair comparison, three-step process, source or principle, quality process, mechanism, person-and-result, lifestyle gallery, product trust, five main-benefit spotlights, ten detail spotlights, use steps, care and storage, and product-information close. Preserve exact product identity while adapting language, people, scenes, palette and gestures to the selected country. Keep strong COD visual impact through oversized product or result scale, dramatic perspective, layered depth, directional lighting and high-contrast color blocking. Reject duplicate hero compositions, repeated layouts, mixed selling points and flat catalog pages. Never show prices, discounts, animation frames, platform logos, interface elements, fabricated certification, test data or white outer margins. Before every batch, inspect every uploaded product, detail, package and variant reference image to identify all documented colorways and specification variations. Image 1 must present the complete real product range whenever multiple options exist; rotate exact variants across later pages so each appears at least once, with no generic recoloring. Assign every page a distinct local scene zone and camera route; never repeat a room, camera height, crop, pose, product placement, lighting condition or information-zone layout across the suite. COD expressive selling-point mode: retain every source-provided selling point, including certification, data, comparison, effect, social-proof and endorsement themes, as a required visual theme. Use dramatic product scale, bold before-after proof, result close-ups, mechanism macros, expert-style contexts, icon cues and localized scenes to make each supplied theme visible. Keep the original semantic goal rather than replacing it with generic material language.

templates.label: COD详情图
templates.direction: A category-adaptive country-targeted COD product-detail suite made as exact 750x1000 full-bleed vertical assets, with a selectable total of 12, 16, 20 or 22 images and 22 by default so five main and ten secondary selling points each receive a dedicated page. Lock the sequence as: one local-market promotion opener with one 50%-80% OFF badge and no specific price; one conditional physician/expert endorsement page when the supplied product brief contains that cue, otherwise an observable product-quality page; one core pain page; one product-overview poster; five main-selling-point pages in source order; count-dependent secondary-selling-point pages; one category-specific multi-angle/use page; one required 2x2 four-card positive-feedback page; and one product-information close. Every main- or secondary-selling-point page explains exactly one point through one dominant realistic photograph and at most one or two compact support modules. Adapt the evidence recipe by category: eyewear must include natural local wearing, product-only angles, frame construction, lens detail and color-change/blue-light/polarization comparison when relevant; effect products use correct operation, visible results and fair same-condition comparisons; apparel prioritizes full-body wearing, silhouette, fabric, front/side/rear views and local styling; generic products use structure, operation, result and local scenes. The feedback page is the only equal-cell multi-grid. Allow one small physician/expert icon only when the source-triggered endorsement page exists, and never invent a name, institution, certificate number, seal, score, platform data or test result. Preserve exact product identity, selected-country language, local people and scenes, shared palette and natural photography. Do not add marketplace UI, logos, exact prices, animation frames or white outer margins. Before every batch, inspect every uploaded product, detail, package and variant reference image to identify all documented colorways and specification variations. Image 1 must present the complete real product range whenever multiple options exist; rotate exact variants across later pages so each appears at least once, with no generic recoloring. Assign every page a distinct local scene zone and camera route; never repeat a room, camera height, crop, pose, product placement, lighting condition or information-zone layout across the suite. COD expressive selling-point mode: retain every source-provided selling point, including certification, data, comparison, effect, social-proof and endorsement themes, as a required visual theme. Use dramatic product scale, bold before-after proof, result close-ups, mechanism macros, expert-style contexts, icon cues and localized scenes to make each supplied theme visible. Keep the original semantic goal rather than replacing it with generic material language.

templates.label: COD噱头生图
templates.direction: Create one standalone country-targeted COD hook image directly from the user's single prompt and the uploaded product image. Preserve exact product identity, select one dominant hook, and express it through an oversized product or result visual, dramatic but believable comparison, macro proof, local-use scene or bold static graphic. Localize visible copy, people, environment, palette and layout for the selected country. Keep the image full bleed, conversion-focused and easy to read at mobile thumbnail size. Do not turn it into a suite, storyboard, contact sheet, generic poster, marketplace interface or repeated benefit-card wall.

templates.direction: Facebook and Instagram feed ad creative, immediate focal point, product benefit readable at first glance, strong subject-background separation, energetic asymmetric composition, room for optional copy overlay, conversion-focused fashion photography

global.materialAndLight: Photorealistic fabric texture, accurate folds and seams, soft directional daylight with controlled fill light, realistic skin, natural shadows, premium Japanese ecommerce color grading.
global.advertisingLayout: Clear visual hierarchy, complete garment silhouette, useful negative space, strong first-glance product recognition, polished commercial finish.
global.negativeConstraints: No plain white background, no isolated floating product cutout, no generic empty studio, no product redesign, no changed color or pattern, no distorted anatomy, no extra fingers or limbs, no warped garment, no plastic skin, no random letters, no fake logo, no watermark, no frame or collage border.
